nodes.name: project.ts
nodes.summary: Defines core TypeScript types for projects, including status/priority/health enums, repository references, and the main Project entity interface used across the app.

nodes.name: shared.ts
nodes.summary: Defines shared cross-cutting types (Person, Label, Team, ContextMenuItem, DropdownOption) reused across work items, projects, and UI components.

nodes.name: viewStatus.ts
nodes.summary: Provides unified status types and color palettes for Kanban, Gantt, Calendar, and List views, plus conversion utilities and helper functions mapping work item status to view-specific colors.
nodes.languageNotes: Consolidates per-view status enums into a single STATUS_COLORS palette and lookup maps, avoiding duplicated color logic across Kanban/Gantt/Calendar components.

nodes.name: workItem.ts
nodes.summary: Consolidated work item type definitions including status/priority enums, core WorkItemBase/WorkItem interfaces, and re-exported orchestrator/agent-workflow types from the project store API.
nodes.languageNotes: Re-exports a large set of orchestrator and agent-workflow types from the backend project-store API layer (@src/api/http/project/types) to give the UI a single consolidated work-item type surface.
